literal: Of love the path it is, the seat of life; to those without that, bone skin covered body.
translation: A body is truly the seat of life only when it stands in the path of love. To those without love, it is merely bone covered with skin.
modern: அன்பின் வழியில் வாழ்வதுதான் உண்மையான உயிருள்ள உடம்பாகும். அந்த அன்பு இல்லாதவர்களுக்கு உடம்பு என்பது வெறும் எலும்பைத் தோலால் போர்த்திய ஒரு கூடு மட்டுமே.
explanation: This couplet defines what it truly means to be alive. The compound word 'uyirnilai' (seat of life) refers to a living being, which the text says exists only in the path of love. Without love, a person is not truly alive; their physical form is reduced to a mere mechanical structure of bones covered by skin. The stark contrast highlights that love is the essential animating force of human existence.
